title: Psalm 140: Rescue from Men of Violence
summary: David asks the LORD to rescue him from evil and violent men who plan harm, stir up conflict, and speak with tongues as poisonous as snakes. He describes their hidden traps, confesses the LORD as his God and the strength of his salvation, and asks that their own schemes fall back on them. The psalm ends in confidence that the LORD upholds justice for the poor and that the upright will dwell in his presence.

line: David asks to be rescued from violent men whose tongues are poisonous as snakes, and trusts that the LORD upholds justice for the poor.
guide: If you have been hurt by slander or a lie that spread, take the hurt to God, who knows that words can poison. Stand where verse 12 stands, with the poor and needy. And ask whether your own words heal or harm.

care.text: Verses 9 to 11 ask God to bring the enemies' own evil down on them. Like the other cursing psalms, this prayer hands the matter to God; the singer does not plan to act himself. The book page's part on the cursing psalms sets out how Christians read such lines. No reading of them makes it right to harm anyone.

stanzas.title: Rescue me from men who plan evil and speak venom
Guard me from their hidden traps
You are my God, my strength and shield
Let their evil return on them
The LORD upholds justice for the poor

verses.t: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. Rescue me, O LORD, from evil men. Protect me from men of violence,
who devise evil in their hearts and stir up war all day long.
They sharpen their tongues like snakes; the venom of vipers is on their lips. Selah
Guard me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked. Keep me safe from men of violence who scheme to make me stumble.
The proud hide a snare for me; the cords of their net are spread along the path, and lures are set out for me. Selah
I say to the LORD, “You are my God.” Hear, O LORD, my cry for help.
O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, You shield my head in the day of battle.
Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked; do not promote their evil plans, lest they be exalted. Selah
May the heads of those who surround me be covered in the trouble their lips have caused.
May burning coals fall on them; may they be thrown into the fire, into the miry pits, never to rise again.
May no slanderer be established in the land; may calamity hunt down the man of violence.
I know that the LORD upholds justice for the poor and defends the cause of the needy.
Surely the righteous will praise Your name; the upright will dwell in Your presence.
